fixed: Online search and title import now find a dance whose title you typed with a curly apostrophe or quote (’ “ ”) or a dash (– —) when the archive spells it with a straight one, and the other way round. Previously "Rory O’More" found nothing in The Caller's Box, and "Eleanor's Reel" found nothing in ContraDB.

added: Add foldTitlePunctuation, titleMatchKey and contraDbTitleQueryVariants for matching online-source titles regardless of apostrophe, quote and dash style.
fixed: canonicalContraDbFigureQuery accepts typographic apostrophes, so "Rory O’More" resolves to the ContraDB figure.
